scenes.narration_en: Suspicion first fell on Phan Duc Lam, the victim's partner in a debt dispute worth over two billion dong. He had been near the scene and had threatened Vu.
The coroner found that Vu had died around 10:15 p.m., more than an hour before Ha's call. Then, beneath a ransacked filing cabinet, investigators found an engraved metal lighter.
But the red mud at the scene did not match Lam's route, and a traffic camera placed him somewhere else at 10:15 p.m.
